natural-curiosity.label: Natural Curiosity
natural-curiosity.description: Shows interest in new ideas and asks questions that help deepen their understanding of the world around them.

thoughtful-questions.label: Thoughtful Questions
thoughtful-questions.description: Asks relevant questions to clarify instructions, explore ideas or develop a better understanding of their learning.

attentive-listening.label: Attentive Listening
attentive-listening.description: Listens carefully to staff and classmates and uses what they hear to guide their work and contributions.

willing-participation.label: Willing Participation
willing-participation.description: Contributes to learning activities and discussions, showing a willingness to become involved and share ideas.

growing-engagement.label: Growing Engagement
growing-engagement.description: Is becoming more involved in learning and showing increasing interest in classroom activities.

consistent-attendance.label: Consistent Attendance
consistent-attendance.description: Attends regularly, helping them maintain learning routines, build relationships and develop their skills over time.

positive-reconnection.label: Positive Reconnection
positive-reconnection.description: Has made encouraging progress in returning to learning and reconnecting with staff, classmates and classroom routines.

ready-to-learn.label: Ready to Learn
ready-to-learn.description: Arrives prepared and settles into learning activities with increasing independence.

persistent-effort.label: Persistent Effort
persistent-effort.description: Keeps working when tasks become challenging and shows determination to make progress.

trying-new-things.label: Trying New Things
trying-new-things.description: Shows a willingness to attempt unfamiliar activities and explore learning beyond their existing interests or strengths.

using-feedback.label: Using Feedback
using-feedback.description: Responds constructively to feedback and uses suggestions to improve their work or approach.

seeking-support.label: Seeking Support
seeking-support.description: Recognises when help is needed and approaches staff or trusted peers for clarification or assistance.

growing-independence.label: Growing Independence
growing-independence.description: Takes increasing responsibility for starting tasks, making decisions and completing work with less prompting.

creative-thinking.label: Creative Thinking
creative-thinking.description: Offers original ideas and explores different ways to express their understanding or solve a problem.

practical-strengths.label: Practical Strengths
practical-strengths.description: Demonstrates ability and engagement in practical activities, using hands-on learning to build and show understanding.

thoughtful-problem-solving.label: Thoughtful Problem-Solving
thoughtful-problem-solving.description: Considers possible solutions, draws on what they already know and adjusts their approach when needed.

working-together.label: Working Together
working-together.description: Works cooperatively with others, shares responsibilities and contributes to a common goal.

encouraging-others.label: Encouraging Others
encouraging-others.description: Offers encouragement and recognises the efforts of classmates, helping others feel more confident about participating.

respectful-communication.label: Respectful Communication
respectful-communication.description: Expresses ideas and responds to others in ways that support positive relationships and productive learning.

including-others.label: Including Others
including-others.description: Helps classmates feel welcome and makes an effort to include others in conversations and activities.

positive-leadership.label: Positive Leadership
positive-leadership.description: Sets a constructive example and helps others participate, stay organised or work towards a shared goal.

managing-challenges.label: Managing Challenges
managing-challenges.description: Is developing effective ways to manage frustration, use support and return to learning after difficulties.

knowing-their-needs.label: Knowing Their Needs
knowing-their-needs.description: Shows awareness of the conditions and support that help them learn, and communicates these needs appropriately.

recognising-progress.label: Recognising Progress
recognising-progress.description: Reflects on their learning, recognises improvements and is developing confidence in what they can achieve.

taking-responsibility.label: Taking Responsibility
taking-responsibility.description: Acknowledges the impact of their actions and takes constructive steps to address difficulties or repair relationships.

personal-progress.label: Personal Progress
personal-progress.description: Has made meaningful progress towards individual learning goals, building skills and confidence from their own starting point.

regular-engagement.label: Regular Engagement
regular-engagement.description: Would benefit from participating more consistently in learning activities, using manageable tasks and agreed support to build momentum.

sustained-effort.label: Sustained Effort
sustained-effort.description: Could strengthen their learning by staying with tasks beyond the initial attempt and using support when the work becomes challenging.

attendance-routines.label: Attendance Routines
attendance-routines.description: Would benefit from working with staff and family or carers to address attendance barriers and establish a more consistent connection with school.

settling-in.label: Settling In
settling-in.description: Could make better use of learning time by following an agreed arrival routine and beginning with a clear, achievable first task.

listening-first.label: Listening First
listening-first.description: Would benefit from listening to the full explanation before beginning and checking any instructions they are unsure about.

clarifying-instructions.label: Clarifying Instructions
clarifying-instructions.description: Could work with greater confidence by asking questions or explaining the task back to staff before proceeding.

checking-in.label: Checking In
checking-in.description: Would benefit from checking in with staff at agreed points to confirm understanding, review progress and identify the next step.

getting-started.label: Getting Started
getting-started.description: Could build independence by identifying the first step of a task and beginning it with the agreed level of support.

maintaining-focus.label: Maintaining Focus
maintaining-focus.description: Would benefit from identifying distractions and using strategies such as shorter work periods, a suitable workspace or planned breaks.

following-through.label: Following Through
following-through.description: Could demonstrate more of their learning by completing agreed tasks and returning to unfinished work with staff support.

planning-ahead.label: Planning Ahead
planning-ahead.description: Would benefit from breaking larger tasks into smaller steps and deciding what needs to happen first, next and last.

managing-time.label: Managing Time
managing-time.description: Could improve task completion by setting manageable work targets and reviewing progress at agreed times.

organising-materials.label: Organising Materials
organising-materials.description: Would benefit from a consistent system for keeping track of equipment, learning materials and completed work.

checking-work.label: Checking Work
checking-work.description: Could improve the accuracy and clarity of their work by reviewing it against instructions, examples or a simple checklist.

adding-detail.label: Adding Detail
adding-detail.description: Could show their understanding more fully by explaining their thinking and including relevant examples or supporting detail.

applying-feedback.label: Applying Feedback
applying-feedback.description: Would benefit from choosing one or two pieces of feedback and making specific changes before moving on to the next task.

asking-for-help.label: Asking for Help
asking-for-help.description: Could avoid becoming stuck by seeking clarification or assistance earlier, using an agreed way to request support.

trying-another-approach.label: Trying Another Approach
trying-another-approach.description: Would benefit from exploring a different strategy when an initial attempt is unsuccessful, with guidance where needed.

building-confidence.label: Building Confidence
building-confidence.description: Could develop greater confidence by attempting manageable challenges and recognising progress, even when the result is not yet perfect.

sharing-ideas.label: Sharing Ideas
sharing-ideas.description: Would benefit from contributing their thinking more often through a format that suits them, such as conversation, writing or a small-group discussion.

sharing-responsibility.label: Sharing Responsibility
sharing-responsibility.description: Could contribute more effectively to group activities by agreeing on a role, completing their part and checking in with the group.

making-space.label: Making Space
making-space.description: Would benefit from allowing others time to speak, listening to different perspectives and sharing opportunities to contribute.

expressing-needs.label: Expressing Needs
expressing-needs.description: Could access support more effectively by communicating when they need clarification, a break, a different approach or additional assistance.

managing-frustration.label: Managing Frustration
managing-frustration.description: Would benefit from recognising early signs of frustration and practising agreed strategies before difficulties interrupt their learning.

returning-to-learning.label: Returning to Learning
returning-to-learning.description: Could maintain progress by following a supported plan for rejoining learning after a break, absence or difficult moment.

repairing-relationships.label: Repairing Relationships
repairing-relationships.description: Would benefit from support to reflect on disagreements, understand their impact and take practical steps to restore positive relationships.

using-support.label: Using Support
using-support.description: Could make greater progress by identifying which available supports are helpful and practising how to use them consistently.

setting-small-goals.label: Setting Small Goals
setting-small-goals.description: Would benefit from choosing a specific, achievable learning goal and regularly reviewing progress with staff.
